evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Speaker supplies a factual reference — the prod failure pattern — as the basis for the assertion, controlling the informational ground rather than invoking rank or personal expertise.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Repeated modal 'must' clauses perform insistence — a pressure tactic that demands compliance through stipulated requirements rather than persuasion or authority of position.
